questions.stem: How can gibberellins be used to produce seedless fruit?

options.text: By stimulating fruit development without the need for fertilisation
By killing the seeds inside the fruit
By removing seeds after the fruit has formed

questions.explanation: Gibberellins can stimulate fruit development without fertilisation occurring, meaning no seeds are produced. This is called parthenocarpy and is used commercially to produce seedless grapes and other fruits.
